XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine malfunction indicator light coming on, with sudden engine shutdown while running
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P0089 | P0091 | FILTER | FUEL | DIESEL | IGNITION | ON | MIL | YELLOW | CAUSES | LOSES | DROPS | LACK | POWER | SPEED | DECREASE | SIGNIFICANT | SIGNIFICANTLY | DRASTIC | DRASTICALLY |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Component: Fuel filter

  • Fault: Significantly reduced performance, with engine fault light illuminated

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis:
  • P0089 (Fuel pressure regulator 1 – Incorrect operating range)
  • P0091 (Fuel pressure regulator 1 – Insufficient value)
  • Cause: Faulty fuel filter

• Action: Check the condition of the fuel filter and, if necessary, clean or replace it.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, following the replacement of the fuel filter, the fault was permanently resolved.
